ctx.x: Now, we also have another program, we want to put onto the record, which I have in my pocket. But these were when they were playing in Philharmonic Hall on Great Portland Street in London. Programs at 2:45 and 8:30. The orchestra, of course, is under the direction of Will Marion Cook.
